'''Kangjiu''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. He is incredibly unlucky.

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Why am I so unlucky...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Morning)
:'''Kangjiu:''' Sigh I'm going to be late for work again... Being chased by a giant whale in my dream wore me out. The alarm clock went off a hundred times, and I still didn't hear it...
:'''Kangjiu:''' If only the butterfly nymph were here, she'd definitely scare away that whale...
----
;(Afternoon)
:'''Kangjiu:''' Ouch! Who left this huge rock in the middle of the road? Ouch... my foot...
:'''Kangjiu:''' This isn't working. I wanted to go to the fairy mountain at sea to get some good luck... With my luck, I might not even see the mountain when I get there...
----
;(Night)
:'''Kangjiu:''' Hmm... What should I eat next?
:'''Kangjiu:''' Wait. Why is my wallet empty? Where's my money...
----
;(Around Midnight)
:'''Kangjiu:''' Why am I always so unlucky...
:'''Kangjiu:''' Once, when I was at sea, a whale broke the hull of our boat. I still lived to see the nymph mountain!
:'''Kangjiu:''' My luck shouldn't be this bad, I haven't seen the butterfly nymph yet...
{{Dialogue End}}
